newsitem.title: GERMANY: Merck says sets up British unit.
newsitem.headline: Merck says sets up British unit.

text.p: German chemicals group Merck KGaA said on Friday that it had reorganised its British business with the foundation of a new unit, Merck UK.

The new company will bring Merck's Seven Seas, Merck Generics and Merck Lipha Pharmaceuticals units, as well as its laboratory and specialist chemical units, under one umbrella group, Merck said in a statement.

The chairman of the new group, which will be based in Poole, will be Edward Roberts, a director at Merck in Darmstadt. The managing director of the new subsidiary will be Robert O'Connell, head of its Merck Ltd unit.
Merck has over 1,800 employees in Britain and said in the statement it expects sales of more than 280 million pounds in 1997.
